text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ma-ya-no! Ma-ya-no!
Ma-ya-no! Ma-ya-no!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …………I won.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I won.
Against Brian-san."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-chan!
I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't Maya amazing?
Wasn't I super sparkly?
choice_data_list: You were the one shining the brightest all along.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~~~n!!
Traaiiineeer~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha... haha,
to think I haven't caught my breath yet."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A total defeat. I gave it my all... and lost.
Still... not bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, this is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Brian!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, right.
That was still left, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —My "retirement ceremony" is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Steadfast and unyielding... Her heart remains unchanged, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The press is already gathered.
It's your ceremony, so at least let us make it grand."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, Brian-san.
The ceremony is scheduled to begin in 5 minutes."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah... I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad that when my legs stopped, it was upon the turf.
Not back at the academy, but right here on the grass.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotta be kidding me!? Brian!
Show us more of your legend!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Please don't quit, I'm begging you~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hah... why mourn?
You'll just dream another dream soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Within her.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: And now, for Narita Brian's retirement ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Stooop!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Maya won't allow it!
Brian-san's retirement ceremony is canceled!!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? B-But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No 'buts' or anything!
Maya hates it! I hate it, so you can't!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Showing up out of nowhere, what's with that selfishness?
You're today's winner, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Think of the influence you carry.
If this is just childish nonsense, take it elsewhere—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya's still just a kid, though!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run a ton with Brian-san from now on and become a grown-up Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Then why can't I say it!
Selfish or not! I'm still a kid!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya hasn't raced enough with Brian-san yet!
Promise me we'll race again next time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: H-Haaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That makes no sense at all! Good grief, today was supposed to be my—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: This is NOT a retirement ceremony!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Haha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly! Don't quit, Brian!
Fight the champion!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Running away just because someone declared war on you—that's not like you at all, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you guys even doing...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you guys understand Brian-san better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya understands even better, you know.
Hey, earlier today, Brian-san wasâ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—You felt like running with Maya again, didn't you?
You wanted to feel even more excited, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's why Maya will hang out
with Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because the more Maya competes with sparkling people,
the more of a sparkling adult she'll become!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Are you telling me to keep running
just to satisfy your own selfishness?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. What a terrifying child.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll be an adult in no time, thoughâ

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You should just admit defeat already,
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not a single person in this venue wants to see you retire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —You yourself, as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right now, it can still be changed. This ceremony... into a different one.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yes! In that case! Maya's gonna make this my official declaration of war ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Hey!? If that happens,
you'll end up being the star of the ceremony yourself—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Booo, come on!
Right, Madam President?!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine. Changing it to a more exciting ceremony
should satisfy the press corps better anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, what a child.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ That's exactly why
you should look forward to seeing me grown up, right?
Exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The more frustrating it is, the more I look forward to it.
